title: 13. Shadow-Shadow Fruit (Kage Kage no Mi)
facts: Fruit look from the user's oparchive screenshots (refs/batch3/DESIGNS.md)

plan.fruit: Drawn from the design you sent (refs/batch3).

lines.text: You take a bite#red of a weird black#purple fruit.
lines.say: You take a bite of a weird black fruit.

lines.text: Don't panic,#red that's just a Devil#purple Fruit.#purple
lines.say: Don't panic, that's just a Devil Fruit.

lines.text: Out of every fruit in the sea,#blue
lines.say: Out of every fruit in the sea,

lines.text: a Paramecia#orange that lets you control#blue shadows, even other people's.
lines.say: a Paramecia that lets you control shadows, even other people's.

lines.text: First, you cut off someone's#blue shadow with giant scissors.#purple
lines.say: First, you cut off someone's shadow with giant scissors.

lines.text: Then you put the shadow#green into a dead body and make a zombie soldier.#orange
lines.say: Then you put the shadow into a dead body and make a zombie soldier.

lines.text: You can even swap places#pink with your own shadow.#red
lines.say: You can even swap places with your own shadow.

lines.text: Your strongest#blue move is Shadow's Asgard: you absorb a thousand#green shadows and become a giant.
lines.say: Your strongest move is Shadow's Asgard: you absorb a thousand shadows and become a giant.

lines.text: People without#pink a shadow vanish if they touch sunlight.#pink
lines.say: People without a shadow vanish if they touch sunlight.

lines.text: Gecko#pink Moria used it on Thriller#blue Bark, until Luffy beat him.
lines.say: Gecko Moria used it on Thriller Bark, until Luffy beat him.

lines.text: Users of this fruit are never alone.#pink
lines.say: Users of this fruit are never alone.

lines.text: Which fruit#pink do you want next?#gold Follow for more.
lines.say: Which fruit do you want next? Follow for more.
